messages.send.title: Send WhatsApp Message
messages.send.description: Send a plain-text WhatsApp message to a recipient phone number via the WhatsApp Cloud API.

to.description: Recipient phone number in international format (e.g. 15551234567).

graphVersion.description: Optional Graph API version like v25.0. Defaults to v25.0 when omitted.

channelId.description: Phone number ID the message was sent from.

text.description: The message text that was sent.

credentials.validate.title: Validate WhatsApp Credentials
credentials.validate.description: Validate that the supplied WhatsApp access token and phone number ID are present and well-formed.

messages.sendTemplate.title: Send WhatsApp Template Message
messages.sendTemplate.description: Send a pre-approved template message to a recipient via the WhatsApp Cloud API. Templates must be approved by Meta before use.

to.description: Recipient phone number in international format.

templateName.description: Name of the approved template to send.

languageCode.description: Template language code (e.g. en_US). Defaults to en_US.

graphVersion.description: Graph API version like v25.0. Defaults to v25.0.

messages.sendImage.title: Send WhatsApp Image Message
messages.sendImage.description: Send an image message to a recipient via the WhatsApp Cloud API using a publicly accessible image URL.

to.description: Recipient phone number in international format.

imageUrl.description: Publicly accessible URL of the image to send.

caption.description: Optional caption text for the image.

graphVersion.description: Graph API version like v25.0. Defaults to v25.0.

messages.sendDocument.title: Send WhatsApp Document Message
messages.sendDocument.description: Send a document (PDF, DOCX, etc.) to a recipient via the WhatsApp Cloud API using a publicly accessible document URL.

to.description: Recipient phone number in international format.

documentUrl.description: Publicly accessible URL of the document to send.

caption.description: Optional caption text for the document.

graphVersion.description: Graph API version like v25.0. Defaults to v25.0.

messages.sendLocation.title: Send WhatsApp Location Message
messages.sendLocation.description: Send a location pin to a recipient via the WhatsApp Cloud API using GPS coordinates.

to.description: Recipient phone number in international format.

graphVersion.description: Graph API version like v25.0. Defaults to v25.0.

messages.sendContacts.title: Send WhatsApp Contacts Message
messages.sendContacts.description: Send one or more vCard contacts to a recipient via the WhatsApp Cloud API.

to.description: Recipient phone number in international format.

contacts.description: Array of WhatsApp contact objects with name and phone fields.

graphVersion.description: Graph API version like v25.0. Defaults to v25.0.

messages.sendReaction.title: Send WhatsApp Reaction
messages.sendReaction.description: React to a specific WhatsApp message with an emoji via the WhatsApp Cloud API.

to.description: Recipient phone number in international format.

messageId.description: Provider message ID (wamid) of the message to react to.

emoji.description: Emoji to react with (e.g. 👍). Send empty string to remove reaction.

graphVersion.description: Graph API version like v25.0. Defaults to v25.0.

messages.markRead.title: Mark WhatsApp Message as Read
messages.markRead.description: Mark an incoming WhatsApp message as read by sending a PUT request with status=read to the WhatsApp Cloud API.

messageId.description: Provider message ID (wamid) of the message to mark as read.

graphVersion.description: Graph API version like v25.0. Defaults to v25.0.

success.description: Whether the message was marked as read.

messages.sendInteractive.title: Send WhatsApp Interactive Message
messages.sendInteractive.description: Send an interactive message with buttons or a list menu to a recipient via the WhatsApp Cloud API.

to.description: Recipient phone number in international format.

interactiveType.description: Type of interactive message: button, list, product, or product_list.

interactive.description: Interactive message body object with header, body, footer, and action fields per WhatsApp spec.

graphVersion.description: Graph API version like v25.0. Defaults to v25.0.

healthcheck.title: Healthcheck
healthcheck.description: Verify connectivity and credentials for the WhatsApp connector. Takes no input and returns the connector health status.

messages.get.title: Get WhatsApp Message
messages.get.description: Fetch a WhatsApp Cloud API message by its provider message ID (wamid) via the Graph API node lookup.

graphVersion.description: Optional Graph API version like v25.0. Defaults to v25.0 when omitted.

templates.list.title: List WhatsApp Templates
templates.list.description: List message templates on a WhatsApp Business Account. Requires the WABA ID; templates must be approved by Meta before they can be sent.

wabaId.description: WhatsApp Business Account ID whose templates to list.

limit.description: Page size for the Graph cursor.

after.description: Graph cursor from a previous page.

graphVersion.description: Optional Graph API version like v25.0. Defaults to v25.0 when omitted.

media.get.title: Get WhatsApp Media
media.get.description: Fetch metadata for an uploaded WhatsApp media object, including a short-lived download URL. This connector does not download the bytes and does not allowlist the CDN host — only graph.facebook.com is reachable.

mediaId.description: Media ID returned by media.upload or an inbound media message.

graphVersion.description: Optional Graph API version like v25.0. Defaults to v25.0 when omitted.

media.description: Media metadata including url, mime_type, sha256, and file_size.

media.upload.title: Upload WhatsApp Media
media.upload.description: Upload media bytes to the WhatsApp Cloud API and receive a media ID that can be used in subsequent send calls. Provide filename, MIME type, and the file contents as base64. The connector posts multipart form data to the phone number's media endpoint.

filename.description: Filename to send with the multipart upload.

mimeType.description: MIME type of the file, such as image/jpeg or audio/ogg.

graphVersion.description: Optional Graph API version like v25.0. Defaults to v25.0 when omitted.

media.delete.title: Delete WhatsApp Media
media.delete.description: Delete an uploaded WhatsApp media object by ID. Inbound media cannot be deleted this way.

graphVersion.description: Optional Graph API version like v25.0. Defaults to v25.0 when omitted.

messages.sendAudio.title: Send WhatsApp Audio Message
messages.sendAudio.description: Send an audio message to a recipient via the WhatsApp Cloud API using a publicly accessible audio URL.

to.description: Recipient phone number in international format.

audioUrl.description: Publicly accessible URL of the audio to send.

graphVersion.description: Graph API version like v25.0. Defaults to v25.0.

messages.sendVideo.title: Send WhatsApp Video Message
messages.sendVideo.description: Send a video message to a recipient via the WhatsApp Cloud API using a publicly accessible video URL.

to.description: Recipient phone number in international format.

videoUrl.description: Publicly accessible URL of the video to send.

caption.description: Optional caption text for the video.

graphVersion.description: Graph API version like v25.0. Defaults to v25.0.

businessProfile.get.title: Get WhatsApp Business Profile
businessProfile.get.description: Fetch the WhatsApp Business Profile for the connected phone number, including about, address, description, email, websites, and vertical.

graphVersion.description: Graph API version like v25.0. Defaults to v25.0.

businessProfile.update.title: Update WhatsApp Business Profile
businessProfile.update.description: Update the WhatsApp Business Profile for the connected phone number. Omitted fields are left unchanged.

about.description: Short about text shown on the business profile.

graphVersion.description: Graph API version like v25.0. Defaults to v25.0.

phoneNumbers.get.title: Get WhatsApp Phone Number
phoneNumbers.get.description: Fetch the connected WhatsApp phone number resource, including verified name, display number, and quality rating.

graphVersion.description: Graph API version like v25.0. Defaults to v25.0.

users.block.title: Block WhatsApp Users
users.block.description: Block one or more WhatsApp users from messaging a business phone number via POST /{phone-number-id}/block_users.

phoneNumberId.description: WhatsApp Business phone number ID assigned by Meta, not the dialable number.

blockUsers.description: Users to block. Each item is {user: international phone number without +}. Maximum 100.

conversationalAutomation.configure.title: Configure Conversational Automation
conversationalAutomation.configure.description: Configure welcome messages, ice-breaker prompts, and commands for a business phone number via POST /{phone-number-id}/conversational_automation.

phoneNumberId.description: WhatsApp Business phone number ID assigned by Meta, not the dialable number.

enableWelcomeMessage.description: Enable the automated welcome message for new conversations.

prompts.description: Ice-breaker prompts shown to customers (max 3, 1-80 characters each).

commands.description: Bot commands (max 30). Each item has command_name and command_description.

flows.create.title: Create WhatsApp Flow
flows.create.description: Create a WhatsApp Flow in DRAFT status for a WABA via POST /{waba-id}/flows.

name.description: Flow name. Maximum 80 characters and unique within the WABA.

categories.description: Flow categories such as OTHER, LEAD_GENERATION, SIGN_UP.

endpointUri.description: HTTPS endpoint that serves Flow data requests.

cloneFlowId.description: Optional existing flow ID to clone.

pricing.maxPriceAgreements.create.title: Create Max Price Agreement
pricing.maxPriceAgreements.create.description: Create a WhatsApp max-price agreement that caps per-message spend for a business via POST /{business-id}/max_price_agreements.

businessId.description: WhatsApp Business Account ID used as the pricing agreement owner.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code such as USD or EUR.

signerName.description: Full name of the person signing the agreement.

signerEmail.description: Email of the person signing the agreement.

messageType.description: Message category this ceiling applies to.

maxPriceMicros.description: Maximum price in micros (1_000_000 micros = 1 unit of currency).

templates.create.title: Create Message Template
templates.create.description: Create a message template on a WABA via POST /{waba-id}/message_templates. Meta must approve the template before it can be sent.

name.description: Unique template name: lowercase alphanumeric plus underscores, max 512 characters.

language.description: Template language code such as en_US.

components.description: Template components. Required when creating from scratch; omit when cloning a library template.

allowCategoryChange.description: Allow Meta to reassign the template category.

libraryTemplateName.description: Exact Template Library name to clone instead of creating from scratch.

libraryTemplateBodyInputs.description: Body-level inputs when cloning a library template.

libraryTemplateButtonInputs.description: Button inputs when cloning a library template.

qrCodes.create.title: Create QR Code
qrCodes.create.description: Create a message QR code with a prefilled message via POST /{phone-number-id}/message_qrdls.

phoneNumberId.description: WhatsApp Business phone number ID assigned by Meta, not the dialable number.

prefilledMessage.description: Message text prefilled when a customer scans the QR code.

uploads.createSession.title: Create Upload Session
uploads.createSession.description: Create a Graph resumable upload session via POST /{app-id}/uploads for large image or video files.

appId.description: Meta app ID that owns the resumable upload session.

fileName.description: Optional file name for the upload session.

templates.delete.title: Delete Message Template
templates.delete.description: Delete a WABA message template by name via DELETE /{waba-id}/message_templates. Names cannot be reused for 30 days.

name.description: Template name. Deletes every language variant of this name unless hsmId is also set.

hsmId.description: Optional template ID. Combined with name, deletes only that language variant.

qrCodes.delete.title: Delete QR Code
qrCodes.delete.description: Permanently delete a message QR code via DELETE /{phone-number-id}/message_qrdls.

phoneNumberId.description: WhatsApp Business phone number ID assigned by Meta, not the dialable number.

qrCodeId.description: 14-character QR code identifier returned at creation time.

phoneNumbers.deregister.title: Deregister Phone Number
phoneNumbers.deregister.description: Deregister a business phone number from Cloud API via POST /{phone-number-id}/deregister. The number cannot send until it is registered again.

phoneNumberId.description: WhatsApp Business phone number ID assigned by Meta, not the dialable number.

activities.list.title: Get Business Account Activities
activities.list.description: List WABA activity history such as phone verifications and user additions via GET /{waba-id}/activities.

after.description: Cursor for the next page of results.

before.description: Cursor for the previous page of results.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return per page (1-100).

since.description: Unix timestamp or ISO-8601 time. Only activities after this time.

until.description: Unix timestamp or ISO-8601 time. Only activities before this time.

activityType.description: Activity type filter, or a comma-separated list of types.

businessAccounts.get.description: Retrieve WABA configuration, review status, and ownership via GET /{waba-id}.

settings.get.description: Get calling, storage, and encryption settings for a phone number via GET /{phone-number-id}/settings.

phoneNumberId.description: WhatsApp Business phone number ID assigned by Meta, not the dialable number.

subscribedApps.list.description: List apps subscribed to WABA webhooks via GET /{waba-id}/subscribed_apps.

subscribedApps.subscribe.description: Subscribe the current app to WABA webhook notifications via POST /{waba-id}/subscribed_apps.

name.description: Unique template name: lowercase alphanumeric plus underscores.

language.description: Template language code such as en_US.

phoneNumbers.verifyCode.title: Verify Phone Number OTP

me.get.title: Who Am I

messages.sendMedia.description: Send an audio, document, image, sticker, or video message by public HTTPS URL via POST /{phone-number-id}/messages.

phoneNumberId.description: WhatsApp Business phone number ID assigned by Meta, not the dialable number.

to.description: Recipient WhatsApp number in international format without +.

link.description: Publicly accessible HTTPS URL of the media file.

caption.description: Optional caption. Supported for image, video, and document only.

replyToMessageId.description: Optional WAMID to quote as a reply.

graphVersion.description: Graph API version such as v25.0. Defaults to v25.0.
